intent: Sustained forward trot at 0.1 m/s on Sesame's 8-joint (2-DoF-per-leg) vertical-axis hips, using diagonal pairs A=(RF,LR) and B=(RR,LF) offset by half a cycle, with mirrored hip cosine waves and diagonal knee flexion; distinct smooth gait variant from prior accepted candidates.

phases.name: stance A / swing B (early)
phases.base_motion: Constant forward x=0.1*t, y=0, constant z=0.04673357 m, zero roll/pitch/yaw.
phases.limb_motion: Pair A (RF,LR) in stance: hips sweep via cos(2*pi*pA) around center 1.604 rad with amplitude 0.263 rad; knees R3/L4 held at pi-0.15. Pair B (RR,LF) in swing: hips cos(2*pi*pB) around mirrored center; knees R4/L3 flex from 0.15 up to 0.15+0.565*sin(pi*sB) with normalized swing phase.

phases.name: stance A / swing B (late)
phases.base_motion: Same constant forward translation and fixed base height.
phases.limb_motion: Pair A continues stance sweep; pair B swing arch descends toward touchdown, knee flexion returning to 0.15 rad at pB=1.0.

phases.name: stance B / swing A (early)
phases.base_motion: Same constant forward translation and fixed base height.
phases.limb_motion: Pair B in stance with knee flexion 0.15; pair A in swing with knee lift arch 0.15+0.565*sin(pi*sA); hips continue mirrored cosine waves.

phases.name: stance B / swing A (late)
phases.base_motion: Same constant forward translation and fixed base height.
phases.limb_motion: Pair B stance sweep completes; pair A swing descends to touchdown, knee flexion back to 0.15 rad, ready to wrap into next cycle.

coding_notes: Exact parameters: freq=2.52 Hz, hip amplitude A=0.263 rad, hip center=1.604 rad, stance knee flex=0.15 rad, swing knee lift=0.565 rad, phase origin=0.105, base height=0.04673357 m. Phase pA = frac(freq*t + 0.105); pB = frac(pA + 0.5). Hip waves: R1=center+A*cos(2*pi*pA); R2=pi-center+A*cos(2*pi*pB); L1=pi-center-A*cos(2*pi*pB); L2=center-A*cos(2*pi*pA). Knee mapping: R3=pi-flexA, L4=pi-flexA, R4=flexB, L3=flexB, where flexA=where(pA>=0.5, 0.15+0.565*sin(pi*(pA-0.5)*2), 0.15) and flexB analogous with pB. Normalize swing phase to 0..1 before sine to avoid wrap discontinuity. Stack q in order R1,R3,R2,R4,L1,L3,L2,L4. Root: x=home['speed']*t, y=0*t, z=0.04673357*(1+0*t); rpy all zero. Contacts: contactA=pA<0.5, contactB=pB<0.5; stack [contactA, contactB, contactB, contactA] for feet order RF,RR,LF,LR. No clipping, no ground correction, no base ripple.
